units: <cite ref="Yoma 35b:5">Yoma 35ᵇ</cite> <he>כחמרא במ׳</he> as the wine shines through a glass cup (be it ever so thick).—Pl. <he>מִזְגֵי</he> or <he>מַזְגֵּי</he>.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 73b:1">B. Bath. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>תרי מ׳ דחמרא</he> (Rashb. <cite ref="K00915"><he>כסי</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 300) two cups of wine. [<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 2:7:6">Y. Nidd. II, 50ᵇ</cite> top <he>וכמזגי אבא וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M00715"><he>מֶזֶג</he></cite>.]
